fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects attempts to exploit an apache spark server via CVE-2014-6287 from a commandline perspective
fields.name: Apache Spark Shell Command Injection - ProcessCreation
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and (src.process.image.path contains "\bash" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "id -Gn `" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "id -Gn '")))
